fields.problem:
Title: Zermelo's Well-Ordering Theorem/Proof 2

Let the [[Axiom:Axiom of Choice|Axiom of Choice]] be accepted.

Then every [[Definition:Set|set]] is [[Definition:Well-Orderable Set|well-orderable]].

0019 | Suppose $s_\beta$ has been defined for all $\beta < \alpha$.
